content: In January 1973, the Naval Station Hospital at Subic Bay expanded its operational scope. This expansion included the integration of dispensaries located at Naval Station Subic Bay, Naval Air Station Cubi Point, the Naval Communication Transmitting Facility in Capas, Tarlac, and the Joint Military Group in Manila. On March 7, 1977, the hospital was officially designated as a Regional Medical Center, reflecting its enhanced role and capabilities. The Naval Hospital operated under the parent command of Naval Forces, Philippines. The hospital had a baseline capacity of 90 beds, with the infrastructure and resources to expand its capacity to accommodate up to 141 beds when necessary.
